_comment: Venues that are a genuine HOME court for a team even though the upstream
feed flags games there neutral. Keyed by teams.short_name, values are
Why this is curated rather than derived: the same building can be a real
home floor and a neutral tournament site. Madison Square Garden is St.
John's home court for regular-season games AND the Big East tournament
venue, where it is neutral for everyone. No rule over venue frequency
separates those -- the candidates a frequency rule surfaces are almost
all conference tournament sites (Bridgestone for the SEC schools,
CenturyLink Boise for the Big Sky, Boardwalk Hall for the MAAC), and
Connecticut's own 11 MSG games across five seasons are the Big East
Postseason games at these venues stay neutral where `games.is_postseason`
says so. That flag is only partly populated (2025 has none at all), so
the exclusion is best-effort; the cost of it missing is one tournament
game a season counted as home.
Only add a venue a team genuinely hosts at. This overrides the source.
